headline: Philippine T-Bond Yields Drop as Government Makes Full Award
summary: The Philippine government made a full award of reissued Treasury bonds as yield rates declined on robust investor demand and lower global crude oil prices.
why: Treasury bond auctions reflect sovereign borrowing costs and domestic liquidity conditions in Southeast Asian market economies.

impacts.name: Philippine 10-Year Government Bond Yield
impacts.why: Strong investor demand and falling oil prices drove sovereign debt yields lower during auction.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: High investor demand at the Treasury auction combined with falling crude oil prices drove Philippine sovereign bond yields down.
